question: At what temperature, for how long and at what heating rate was the slag fused with NaOH to make CGFS-AFAC-800?
question_long: At what temperature, for how long and at what heating rate was the coal gasification fine slag fused with NaOH to make CGFS-AFAC-800?
expect: 800 °C for 30 min at 10 °C/min under N2 (activation ratio 0.4) (sec. 2.1)
